name: Provider link
summary: “Manage account on Bluesky”: a link to the provider's own site that names the provider and says it opens a new tab.

when: Where people may want to manage their account on their provider's site, such as an app's account settings.

props.name: provider
props.description: The provider: a known provider's id, or its name.

props.name: sameTab
props.description: Opens in the same tab instead of a new one. Leave it off where leaving would lose someone's place.

accessibility.name: Its text, including the provider and the new tab hint.
screenReader: Read as a link: “Manage account on Bluesky (opens in a new tab)”.

guidelines: Always name the provider: the account lives there, not in the app.

dosAndDonts.dont: Say “Manage your account” without saying where.

evidence.point: People manage their account at their provider; naming it teaches where the account lives (prototype research).
